name: Tokidoki Tactical Squad
source:
Boot up a retro military simulation and take on the role of Iris, a squad leader battling to keep her friends alive in a world decimated by a ruthless viral infection.

Will you uncover the secrets of your military corps? Or will you succumb to the pain of losing everything you hold dear?

[From [url=https://cuteshadow.itch.io/tokidoki-tactical-squad]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
启动复古军事模拟游戏，扮演艾丽丝（Iris）的角色，她是一名班长，在一个被无情的病毒感染摧毁的世界中为让她的朋友们活下去而奋斗。

你会揭开你的军团的秘密吗？或者你会屈服于失去你所珍视的一切的痛苦吗？

[来自[url=https://cuteshadow.itch.io/tokidoki-tactical-squad]itch.io[/url]]
